cited.quote: The second multimodal logistics park in the State is being established at Coimbatore for which Land acquisition is under progress.

rationale: C1 reports a Chennai park with Phase 1 under implementation and a Coimbatore park with land acquisition under way, but no Thoothukudi park and no dated GO or launch. Only some locations have concrete steps and none is operational, so in_progress.

cited.quote: Balanced and inclusive regional development remains another important area of focus.

rationale: C1 describes the Focus Blocks programme from the 2023-24 budget, which predates this government. C2 and C3 give general statements on regional balance. No extract shows a budget or official step by this government to close the gap between districts.

cited.quote: Priority is being accorded to the renovation of such temples

rationale: Extracts cover general temple renovation funds (C1, C2) and statewide GIS planning orders (C4, C5). None formulates a special plan for non-structure-damaging renovation or drainage repair in Thanjavur, Madurai, Kanchipuram or Mahabalipuram.

cited.quote: Poompuhar organized fundamental Skill Development Training Programmes and Design & Technology Development Workshops

rationale: C1 and C5 describe artisan training in 2025-26 and a continuing yearly target. This is the same activity carrying on, not a new dedicated measure for artists in the cultural cities. No new GO or scheme is shown.

cited.quote: the Government will comprehensively develop Mahabalipuram into a global tourism destination

rationale: C3 is a budget speech with announcements (Mahabalipuram proposal to the Union, riverfront allocation, food and arts festivals). Budget announcements are not operationalisation. C1, C2 are general tourism text. No GO or launch is shown.
No extract mentions the Nanguneri Special Economic Zone or a free trade warehousing zone. C1 and C3 are about the state warehousing corporation's godowns, which is a different subject.

cited.quote: scholarships ranging from Rs.2,000 to Rs.15,000 per annum are provided to students in 40 disciplines

rationale: C1 shows a general weavers' children scholarship trust set up in 1986, which predates this government and is not a new measure for Design and Textile Engineering. No extract shows a new step for this promise. C3 and C4 concern other groups.

cited.quote: Driven by an 8.6% CAGR, state exports nearly doubled from USD 26.15 billion to USD 52.07 billion

rationale: C2 reports past services-export figures and C1, C3 refer to the AI Mission and Deep Tech policy. No extract mentions a Tamil Nadu AI Export Scheme or a Rs.35 thousand crore target by 2031.

cited.quote: Smart Family Cards are being issued based on Aadhaar enrolment and the registered mobile number

rationale: The promise refers to an entitlement card for services. C1 and C3 describe the existing ration smart family cards, which carry on from 2017. No extract shows a new entitlement card or an order creating one.

cited.quote: additionally Rs.217.63 crore have been sanctioned for the expansion of the scheme
Breakfast Scheme is being implemented across Tamil Nadu for students studying in Classes 1 to 8

rationale: C1 says classes VI to VIII in Government and aided schools are being expanded in 2026-27 with Rs.217.63 crore sanctioned. C2 says classes 1 to 8 are covered, but C4 says it will be extended. No GO or dated launch is shown, so no realisation date can be given.
No extract mentions a Drivers' Day. C2 is about driver training schools and C3 about safety driver awards in 2021-22. These are different subjects.

cited.quote: Procurement of Paddy from 4,316 Direct Purchase Centers and Ragi from 16 Direct Purchase Centers

rationale: C2 describes procurement through direct purchase centres but shows no order or step on commission-free procurement or action against those collecting commission. C3 is an unrelated tender rules amendment.

cited.quote: Five hubs staffed by specialist doctors will be linked to 200 spokes at Primary Health Centres

rationale: C1 announces a telemedicine hub-and-spoke network in the budget, which is a related but different scheme and only an announcement. No extract mentions Makkal Nalan Nilaiyams or any official step to establish 3,000 of them.

cited.quote: essential commodities such as rice, wheat, sugar and kerosene have been distributed to the public through Fair Price Shops

rationale: C1 and C2 describe the existing public distribution system. No extract shows an order or scheme to supply non-rice ration goods in sealed packets.
No extract is about a solar terminal for forest-dwelling indigenous people. C1 and C2 concern rooftop solar on buildings and C4 and C5 concern elephant corridors.

cited.quote: it is being reiterated by the Government of Tamil Nadu to the Union Government persistently and periodically

rationale: C1 mentions a May 2022 request, which predates this government, and a general statement that the demand is reiterated. No dated formal step such as a resolution or letter after 2026-05-10 is shown.

cited.quote: improving compliance, plugging leakages, rationalising rates, fees and exemptions, and identifying new and under tapped sources

rationale: C5 is G.O.(Ms.) No.148 dated 24.07.2026 constituting a Revenue Augmentation Committee on financial management. The indicator asks only that policies be announced, and this GO is one official measure. C4 adds planned industrial policy.

cited.quote: improving compliance, plugging leakages, rationalising rates, fees and exemptions, and identifying new and under tapped sources
Guidance is coordinating with 42 Departments for the implementation of 222 reforms under DBRAP 2025

rationale: C3 is G.O.(Ms.) No.148 of 24.07.2026 setting up a committee to recover revenue lost to leakages and corruption. The investment side in C1 and C4 is ongoing reform coordination and plans for a future policy, with no dated order. Only the revenue part has an official step.

cited.quote: Under this scheme, 1,189 students have been awarded prizes to date.

rationale: C1 describes an existing prize for reciting all 1,330 couplets, running since the start of the millennium. It is not a prize and scholarship for mastering 300 verses, and no new step after the government took office is shown.

cited.quote: Tamil Nadu Coconut Processing Corporation will be established by the Department of Agricultural Marketing and Agri Business

rationale: C1 (agriculture budget speech) and C2 (policy note) say the corporation will be established, with an allocation. These are announcements in future tense. No GO, incorporation or other official step is shown.
